about: Starter packs by type of business (spec smf-spec-onboarding-v2.md rev 12, N3). Bundled with the Social Media Factory, read by the onboarding page on this computer: nothing is fetched. A pack only suggests what is general to a trade, never what only the owner can say. Every suggestion is shown as 'Suggested for <pack>. Please check' and nothing counts until the owner keeps it. Packs hold no statistics, prices or claims of results. 'suggestions' may only fill the allowlisted fields (audience_who, audience_way, myths, mistakes, rules, platforms); questions, objections and steps get 'topic_ideas' instead (post ideas, never answers). 'compliance_candidate' only suggests a compliance pack; the owner turns it on. Change a pack: raise 'version'.
